ellie.partnerships: Heads-up: Aurora Systems asked us to co-host a compact hands-on session + 3-station micro-lab at Aurora Summit (EU). They want a Marketplace tile release tied to the session. Can we sketch owners and non-negotiable deadlines?
maya.events: Sounds good. What are Aurora's non-negotiables?
ellie.partnerships: Two speaker bits (10m intro + 25m joint demo), 3 loaner rigs, marketplace tile + 60s demo video, and FR captioning.
ryan.engineer: For the demo we need a pinned sandbox model, a simple runbook, and a recorded fallback if hardware delayed. Also a demo token limit.
luca.partner: I can run the integration demo. Ill prepare a trimmed script and a container; will need sandbox creds and a small sample dataset by Mon.
zoe.logistics: SWAG ask: co-branded stickers x100 and 50 lapel pins. EU shipping cutoff in ~11 business days. Who approves art?
maya.events: Maya to coordinate design and submit PO tomorrow AM. Zoe, can you confirm courier options for 3 units handcarry?
ryan.engineer: Dry-run slots: Tue 09:00-10:00 UTC & Thu 15:00-16:30 UTC. Dry-run must cover deploy, install, and GPU-failure fallback.
luca.partner: If loaners fail we stream the demo from a VM and show the pre-recorded failover clip (~45s).
deploy-bot: demo-pool request #4120 queued: 2 GPU nodes reserved 2026-07-05T08:00:00Z -> 2026-07-05T11:00:00Z.
ellie.partnerships: Action owners: Maya (art + page), Zoe (swag + courier), Ryan (demo pool + runbook), Luca (slides + container + creds). Ill compile timeline and send invites. :sparkles:
